title: A wholesaler’s forecast for a furniture maker
titleZh: 批發客戶的秋季家具預測
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 | Planning email
From: Imani Hart, Factory Planning
To: Marcel Vega, Wholesale Accounts
Subject: What belongs in Rowan’s autumn forecast

The point of this forecast is to tell the factory what to prepare for, not to treat a retailer’s enthusiasm as a purchase order. Include quantities the retailer’s buyer still expects to take at the quoted specification and price. We can include those before the formal order arrives. Show projects that still depend on a change to our offer in a separate list, as opportunities rather than forecast demand.

A buyer’s preferred design is not always additional volume. If the new design would take the place of an item already on the forecast, reassign that demand; if the buyer can go ahead with both designs, show both. Do not move demand merely because Rowan has asked for a design sample.

When a delivery is divided between sites, use the place where the items will first be offered for sale to assign the sales territory. A transfer through a warehouse does not change the territory. For production planning, show the last factory departure that still allows the buyer to sell on the intended date, not the date the goods appear in stores.

Keep confirmed sales figures even when they won’t generate factory work. For the factory plan, set aside new production only for the demand that Rowan hasn’t committed to meeting with units it already owns.

DOCUMENT 2 | Reply with account notes
From: Marcel Vega, Wholesale Accounts
To: Imani Hart, Factory Planning
Subject: Re: What belongs in Rowan’s autumn forecast

Mara, Rowan’s buyer, says the Arc benches are still in her launch plan on the terms we sent. She cannot issue the paperwork until her assistant returns. The Cove benches are in the same presentation, but her finance team will back them only if we absorb the freight surcharge. I have not offered to do that.

For the Pier desk, Rowan requested a sample of the rounded version for a photograph. It has told us to plan for the square version. The switch it authorized was for the Wave chair: the showroom can display only one Wave, and Mara told me to replace the planned high-back order with the low-back version. She has retained the same opening quantity.

The Elm side tables will all go to Rowan’s East distribution center. Staff there will send half on to West stores before the range goes on sale; the other half will be sold in East stores. For the Oak stools, the setup team needs everything at its site on September 12. The carrier confirmed that September 8 is the last day the factory can send a load and make that setup date. Stores are due to start selling on September 15.

Mara also confirmed the autumn quantities for the Pine racks and Ash cabinets. She is moving Rowan’s Pine racks from two stores that are closing to the autumn sales locations, so she won’t take a new delivery of that model. The Ash cabinets in Rowan’s central warehouse could cover its autumn quantity, but Mara has committed those units to a separate launch in another market. She wants a fresh delivery to cover the forecast here.
passageZh:
文件 1｜生產規劃電郵
寄件者：工廠規劃部 Imani Hart
收件者：批發業務部 Marcel Vega
主旨：Rowan 秋季預測應納入哪些資料

這份預測是讓工廠知道該準備什麼，不是把零售商有興趣當成採購訂單。凡是買方仍打算按報價所列規格及價格採購的數量，都可在正式訂單送達前納入。若某個案子必須等我們修改報價或方案才成立，請另列為潛在商機，不要納入需求預測。

買方偏好的新設計不一定代表額外數量。若新設計會取代已納入預測的品項，就把該筆需求移到新設計；若買方能同時採用兩個設計，就兩個都列。不要只因 Rowan 索取樣品就轉移需求。

若貨品分送多個據點，請按照商品首次對外販售的地點劃分銷售區域。貨經過倉庫轉運，不會改變所屬區域。就生產規劃而言，要填寫仍能讓買方如期開始銷售的最晚出廠日期，而不是商品上架日期。

已確認的銷售需求即使不會帶來工廠工作，仍應保留在銷售預測中。至於工廠計畫，只有 Rowan 尚未承諾以自有庫存供應的需求，才需預留產能安排新生產。

文件 2｜業務回信與客戶紀錄
寄件者：批發業務部 Marcel Vega
收件者：工廠規劃部 Imani Hart
主旨：回覆：Rowan 秋季預測應納入哪些資料

Rowan 採購負責人 Mara 說，Arc 長椅仍按我方發出的條件列在上市計畫內。她得等助理回來才能開出採購文件。Cove 長椅也列在同一份簡報裡，但其財務部只有在我們吸收運費附加費時才會支持這個品項。我還沒承諾吸收這筆費用。

Pier 書桌方面，Rowan 為了拍照索取圓角款樣品，但要求我們按方角款規劃。真正核准更換的是 Wave 椅：展示間只能展示一款 Wave，Mara 要我把原先計畫訂購的高背款改為低背款。她維持原訂首批數量。

Elm 邊桌都會先送到 Rowan 的東區配送中心。該中心會在系列上市前把其中一半轉送西區門市；另一半會在東區門市販售。至於 Oak 高腳椅，陳設團隊需在 9 月 12 日於現場收到全部貨品。承運商確認，工廠最晚須在 9 月 8 日出貨才能趕上陳設日。門市預計 9 月 15 日開賣。

Mara 也確認了 Pine 置物架和 Ash 櫃子的秋季需求量。她會把兩間即將歇業門市的 Rowan 自有 Pine 置物架調到秋季銷售據點，所以不會再收一批這個型號的貨。Rowan 中央倉庫裡的 Ash 櫃子雖足以供應秋季需求量，但 Mara 已承諾用那批貨供應另一個市場的上市計畫。本地預測的需求，她希望用新交付的貨來供應。
